dayPatrons.monday: the honorable, bodiless Powers of Heaven
dayPatrons.tuesday: the honorable, glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist John
dayPatrons.wednesday: the power of the precious and life-giving Cross
dayPatrons.thursday: the holy, glorious, and all-laudable Apostles; our father among the saints Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia
dayPatrons.friday: the power of the precious and life-giving Cross

communionHymns.sunday: Praise the Lord from the heavens, praise Him in the highest. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!
communionHymns.monday: He maketh His angels spirits, and His ministers a flame of fire. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!
communionHymns.tuesday: The righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance; he shall not fear evil tidings. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!
communionHymns.wednesday: O taste and see that the Lord is good. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!
communionHymns.thursday: Their proclamation has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the universe. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!
communionHymns.friday: Salvation is created in the midst of the earth, O God. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!
communionHymns.saturday: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous; praise befits the just. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

1.refrain: Let Thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, as we have set our hope on Thee!
1.verse: Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous! Praise befits the just!

2.refrain: The Lord is my strength and my song; He has become my salvation.
2.verse: The Lord has chastened me sorely, but He has not given me over to death.

3.refrain: Sing praises to our God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.
3.verse: Clap your hands, all ye nations; shout unto God with the voice of rejoicing.

4.refrain: O how magnified are Thy works, O Lord; in wisdom hast Thou made them all.
4.verse: Bless the Lord, O my soul; O Lord my God, Thou art very great.

5.refrain: Thou, O Lord, shalt protect us and preserve us from this generation forever.
5.verse: Save me, O Lord, for there is no longer any that is godly!

6.refrain: O Lord, save Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance!
6.verse: To Thee, O Lord, will I call. O my God, be not silent to me!

7.refrain: The Lord shall give strength to His people. The Lord shall bless His people with peace.
7.verse: Offer to the Lord, O you sons of God! Offer young rams to the Lord!

8.refrain: Pray and make your vows before the Lord our God.
8.verse: In Judah is God known; His name is great in Israel.

1: God gives vengeance unto me, and subdues people under me.
He magnifies the salvation of the King and deals mercifully with David, His anointed, and his seed forever.
2: May the Lord hear thee in the day of trouble! May the name of the God of Jacob protect thee!
Save the King, O Lord, and hear us on the day we call!
3: In Thee, O Lord, have I hoped; let me never be put to shame.
Be Thou a God of protection for me, a house of refuge in order to save me.
4: Go forth, and prosper, and reign, because of truth and meekness and righteousness.
Thou lovest righteousness and hatest iniquity.
5: I will sing of Thy mercies, O Lord, forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Thy truth from generation to generation.
For Thou hast said: Mercy will be established forever; Thy truth will be prepared in the heavens.
6: He who dwelleth in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the heavenly God.
He will say to the Lord: My Protector and my Refuge; my God, in Whom I trust.
7: It is good to give thanks to the Lord, to sing praises to Thy Name, O Most High.
To declare Thy mercy in the morning, and Thy truth by night.
8: Come, let us rejoice in the Lord; let us make a joyful noise to God our Savior.
Let us come before His face with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise unto Him with psalms.

monday.refrain: Who maketh His angels spirits, His servers a flaming fire.
monday.verse: Bless the Lord, O my soul; O Lord my God, Thou art become very great.

tuesday.refrain: The righteous shall rejoice in the Lord, and he shall hope in Him.
tuesday.verse: Hear my prayer, O God, when I pray unto Thee.

wednesday.refrain: My soul doth magnify the Lord, and my spirit hath rejoiced in God my Savior.
wednesday.verse: For He hath looked upon the humility of His servant; for behold from henceforth all generations shall bless me.

thursday.refrain: Their sound is gone forth into all the earth; their sayings to the ends.
thursday.verse: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament proclaimeth His handiwork.

friday.refrain: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at His footstool, for He is holy.
friday.verse: The Lord hath reigned, let the people rage.

saturday.refrain: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous.
saturday.verse: Blessed are they whose transgressions are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

verses: Praise ye the Lord, all His angels; praise ye Him all His powers.
For He spoke, and they came into being; He commanded and they were created.
The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree; like the cedars of Lebanon.
They that are planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts.
Hearken, O Daughter, and see, and incline thine ear.
The rich among the people of the earth shall entreat thy countenance.
The heavens confess Thy wonders, O Lord, Thy truth in the church of the saints.
God, who is glorified in the council of the saints.
Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast possessed from the beginning.
God is our King before the ages; He hath wrought salvation in the midst.
The righteous cried, and the Lord heard them, and delivered them out of all tribulations.
Many are the tribulations of the righteous, but out of them all will the Lord deliver them.
Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen and taken, O Lord; their memory is from generation to generation.

meatfare.refrain: Great is our Lord, and abundant in power; His understanding is beyond measure.
meatfare.verse: Praise the Lord! For it is good to sing praises to our God!

cheesefare.refrain: Pray and make your vows before the Lord, our God!
cheesefare.verse: In Judah God is known; His name is great in Israel.

verses: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel also was among those who called on His Name.
They called to the Lord and He answered them.
He who dwelleth in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the heavenly God.
He will say to the Lord: "My Protector and my Refuge; my God, in Whom I trust."
The mouth of the righteous shall meditate wisdom, and his tongue shall speak of judgment.
secondary.label: St. Gregory Palamas

verses: Remember Thy congregation, which Thou hast purchased of old!
God is our King before the ages; He has worked salvation in the midst of the earth!
Come, let us rejoice in the Lord! Let us make a joyful noise to God our Savior!
Let us come before His face with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him with songs of praise!
Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord; in His commandments shall he greatly delight.
His seed shall be mighty upon the earth; the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
